text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During lunch, I notice Satono Diamond
and
Kitasan Black having a serious
conversation.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the tea party idea was a little
too
formal? Maybe we should've gone
with something
more casual.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so? What kind of casual
gathering
do you think the maintenance
staff would enjoy?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer! What perfect timing!
choice_data_list: 整備員さんって、この間の？

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. You see, we tried inviting all the
staff to
join us for a tea party, but...

text_block_list.name: Track Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
A thank-you tea party? Aw, I'm touched,
but you
don't have to do anything like
that for me!

text_block_list.name: Track Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
Maintaining the track is my job. So long
as you all
can run free of concern, that's
more than enough
for me!

text_block_list.name: Dorm Housemother
text_block_list.text:
Instead of worrying about us, just make
sure to
eat and sleep properly so you
can stay healthy!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: They all turned us down...
Oh! There you are, Satono!
choice_data_list: それで代案を探してたんだな
それで代案を探してたんだね

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: What? This is from McQueen?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She said it was a thank-you gift! She's
out on a
trip, so she asked me to give it
to you instead.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She was really happy when you cheered
her on! It
gave her the extra boost she
needed!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Really? I'm glad to hear it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm glad, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well... I feel happy, but at the same
time, I feel
kind of guilty too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I cheered for her because I wanted to.
That's
hardly deserving of a gift.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
She really didn't have to go out of her
way to—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Track Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
A thank-you tea party? Aw, I'm touched,
but you
don't have to do anything like
that for me!

text_block_list.name: Dorm Housemother
text_block_list.text:
Instead of worrying about us, just make
sure to
eat and sleep properly so you
can stay healthy!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Could it be the staff felt the same way?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I see now. They aren't supporting us
because
they want compensation.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
They do so because they wish for us to
fulfill our
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...So words and gifts aren't the right way
to show
our gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
There's only one thing we can do to
make the
staff's wish come true...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: The staff's wish?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um, sorry, could you fill me in on what
you're
talking about?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. All right, then. Lend me your ears!
choice_data_list: 俺も力にならせてくれ！

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I'll help prepare everything
and let
everyone know, then. ♪

text_block_list.name: Dia and Kitasan
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And that's why we'd love to have your
help!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Gotcha. Well, count me in!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We'll have to give our all to make this an
event to
remember! Let's pour our very
hearts and souls
into this!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Excuse us! We couldn't help
overhearing, but
well... Is there anything
we can do to help?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Satono Diamond's plan is put
into
motion!
